steps.name: owner creates a scoped, expiring API token (only its sha256 is stored)
tool opens an import with the token → awaiting_upload in inbox/
same idempotency key replays the same import (no duplicate)
the tool cannot upload to an inbox path it was not given
steps.error: new row violates row-level security policy

steps.name: the tool uploads the package to its exact inbox path (anonymous, token-gated)
the uploaded package cannot be overwritten

steps.name: the tool confirms the upload → received (waits for owner review)
the token cannot read the library
the OWNER processes the delivery under their own session → registered version
the tool can read only the status of its own delivery
